heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: The cost of living must be lowered for every Floridian

heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: Families are working harder than ever and still finding economic security out of reach. Nowhere is that squeeze sharper than in Florida, where soaring housing costs and some of the highest property insurance premiums in the country stretch families’ budgets to their breaking point.

heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: Make housing and property insurance more affordable so Floridians can stay in their homes and aren’t forced into 90-minute commutes just to afford where they live.

heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: Lower prescription drug costs so Floridians can afford the lifesaving medications they need without sacrificing groceries, rent, or other essentials.

heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: Make childcare more affordable so parents don’t have to choose between going to work and affording quality care for their children.

heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: End illegal and costly tariffs so families aren’t forced to pay higher prices for groceries, household goods, and everyday essentials.

heading: Lowering Costs for All Floridians
text: My goal is simple: a Florida where working families don’t just keep up, but get ahead — where we shift our focus from helping Americans survive to helping them thrive.

heading: Cleaning Up a Broken Washington
text: Government should work for you, not for the insiders and the well-connected.

heading: Cleaning Up a Broken Washington
text: I’m not a career politician. I’m an educator, policy advocate and tech executive who spent my career building institutions to deliver for people. Too often, our government is prioritizing billionaires over everyday families. It’s time to change the rules that allow that to happen.

heading: Cleaning Up a Broken Washington
text: I’ll fight to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks and profiting from public office. I will get big money out of politics by ending Citizens United and putting voters back at the center of our democracy. Finally, I will ban prediction-market betting by members of Congress and establish congressional term limits.

heading: Cleaning Up a Broken Washington
text: In a district like ours, the problems people talk about most — the cost of insurance, hurricane and flood resilience, the price of prescription drugs, protecting Social Security and Medicare, restoring the Everglades — don’t belong to one party, and neither do the solutions.

heading: Cleaning Up a Broken Washington
text: I’ll work with anyone, Democrat, Republican, or Independent, who’s serious about delivering for the families, seniors, workers, and small businesses of Florida. I’ll show up in every part of this district, not just the places that already agree with me. Because America works best when we put people over politics, root out corruption, and focus on making real progress that lasts.

heading: Defending America’s Promise
text: We must protect the freedoms and programs that support all of us.

heading: Defending America’s Promise
text: A teacher, a nurse, a firefighter, all pay into Social Security and Medicare with every paycheck, for an entire working life. They’ve earned every dollar of the security those programs provide.

heading: Defending America’s Promise
text: I will fight to protect Social Security and oppose any effort to cut benefits, raise the retirement age, or hand the program over to Wall Street. I will reverse Medicaid cuts so families, children, seniors, and people with disabilities can continue to get the care they need, and will protect Medicare for future generations.

heading: Defending America’s Promise
text: The fairest way to keep these programs strong for generations to come is to ask the wealthiest Americans to pay their fair share — not to balance the budget on the backs of the people who built this country. And that same promise extends to our veterans, who kept their commitment to us and deserve a country that keeps its commitment to them, with the health care, benefits, and respect they’ve earned.

heading: Strong Schools, Bright Futures
text: Every child deserves a great education no matter where they come from.

heading: Strong Schools, Bright Futures
text: Great schools are how we keep the American Dream within reach for the next generation — and I’ll fight for them in Washington the way I fought for my students in the classroom. I taught in public schools serving low-income communities. At 28, I was founding principal of a public high school where the majority of my students lived in low-income households. Despite the odds, every single graduate earned admission to college. I know what’s possible when we give every child a real shot, no matter their zip code.

heading: Strong Schools, Bright Futures
text: I will fight to make sure our public schools are fully funded, and our teachers get the support they need to make sure every student can succeed. I support universal pre-K, so every child can have an equal head start. Finally I will expand job training and apprenticeship opportunities for young people. Our economy is changing and we need to make sure our education system is invested in skill sets that will be needed in the future.

heading: Strong Schools, Bright Futures
text: I have spent my career focused on helping kids get a better education, not on politics. I am ready to take the lessons I learned in the classroom and bring them to the halls of Congress.

heading: Protecting Personal Freedom
text: Every American should be free to make their own decisions about their body, their family, and their future.

heading: Protecting Personal Freedom
text: I will fight to make sure all personal healthcare decisions stay between a woman and her doctor. The government should never have a say in your healthcare plan. I will defend equal rights under the law so every American no matter who they are or who they love can live with the freedom they deserve. Who you are and where you come from should never limit how far you can go. My parents came to this country to accomplish the American dream, and I want to make sure every American has that same opportunity.

heading: Protecting Personal Freedom
text: Freedom means government stays out of the most personal decisions of your life. The choices you and your family make about your health and your future belong to you, not to politicians in Washington.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: What is a sanguine new congressional candidate to do when the district they thought they were running in gets torn apart by a governor’s best efforts to gerrymander his state at the president’s behest?

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: For Pia Dandiya, a first-time candidate for the Democratic party in Florida, the answer was simple: pick up some maps, hit the road, and embrace the challenge of conquering a different part of the state.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: Dandiya, a professional educator dipping her toe for the first time into the often tenebrous world of electoral politics, originally declared her candidacy for Florida’s 21st congressional district, where she was mounting a long-shot campaign to unseat the Republican congressman Brian Mast, an army veteran who bills himself as “Florida’s America first fighter”.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: But then Ron DeSantis, the Republican governor of Florida and Donald Trump loyalist, intervened. In the consequent Democratic shuffle of candidates, she switched to Florida’s newly configured 22nd – an open seat that Democrats see as one of their best opportunities to reclaim the House majority in November. “Redistricting, to me, represents what people just hate about politics, that it seems like a solution in search of a problem instead of actually solving the problems that are keeping people up at night,” Dandiya said during a meeting over coffee in south Florida last month.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “I would argue that most families are not staying up at night worried about the congressional lines across the state, but they are staying up at night wondering how they’re going to make ends meet, about whether we are handing our children a country, that we are leaving them in good hands.” Florida’s new congressional map was one front in an extraordinary national redistricting campaign, encouraged by Trump to shore up Republicans’ narrow House majority. In Florida, DeSantis’s unprecedented mid-decade “gerrymander” was expected to put as many as four additional House seats within Republicans’ reach, giving them the edge in 24 of the state’s 28 congressional districts.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: With time ticking quickly towards the 18 August primary against attorney Kaysia Earley, the only other Democrat in the race, Dandiya has amassed a string of prominent endorsements. This month, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee added her to its coveted Red to Blue program, signaling that national Democrats view her as a top recruit for the district.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: Formerly enclosed almost entirely in Palm Beach county, district 22 was expanded by DeSantis’s tinkering into a so-called Frankenstein district, stitching together an expansive, diverse swath of south Florida from populated areas on the east and west coasts with sizable rural, agricultural areas in between.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: The redrawn 22nd district, once a solid blue urban stronghold, now “leans Republican”, according to Sabato’s Crystal Ball at the University of Virginia’s Center for Politics, but in reality few are certain what to expect given its untested, divergent demographic.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: For Dandiya, who was born in Palm Beach county, and was a White House fellow at the education department during the Biden administration, the sudden and unexpected switch could have been overwhelming, and at the very least presented a steep learning curve.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: But the first-generation American, whose parents immigrated from India, and mother of a three-year-old son, said she was never going to back down from the challenge.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “I’m a teacher, so I love learning, and I love diving in head first,” she said.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “And all the places that are in my district are places that I have visited growing up and as an adult. I think of this the way that I think of having run a high school, it’s similar to running for office, same mission, potentially different environment. And we’re gonna give it our all.”

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: Giving it her all has resulted in long days and higher than expected mileage crisscrossing the state, and speaking to groups of voters and at community events in cities and counties ranging from heavily Democratic to fervently Republican.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: There is no mystery to it, she said. Only a desire to meet people where they are, and listen to their grievances, anxieties and priorities, which she said are common to all, wherever she has traveled. Dandiya transferred over from her original district with a substantial war chest, fundraising that has now risen to more than $2m, and carries the endorsement of a significant number of Florida Democratic heavyweights, including the state chair, Nikki Fried, US congresswoman Lois Frankel and a host of state representatives and senators.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: She has also won the backing of Florida AFL-CIO, the state’s largest public labor union, and Emily’s List, the influential advocacy group supporting Democratic pro-choice women for elected office.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “With her background in education, policy, and innovation, she is ready to bring a new kind of leadership to Washington,” Emily’s List said in its endorsement. “One focused on progress, opportunity and putting people over politics.”

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: Dandiya said she was heartened by the reception she has received in places that only two months ago she never envisaged visiting, at least not as a congressional candidate.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “The way folks have come out of the woodwork to get excited about being involved in the campaign, figuring out how they can help using their organizing brains and their connecting brains, has just been truly encouraging,” she said.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “I’ve become very convinced on the campaign trail that most families want the same things for their lives, they want stability for my generation, they want safety and dignity for my parents’ generation, and they want a world of opportunity for my three-year-old son’s generation.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “That rings true in district 22 as much as it does in district 21. What is on south Florida families’ minds, and across the state of Florida, I should say, is very similar. What we are experiencing is universal, it’s not Democratic, it’s not independent, it’s not Republican, it’s what all of us are experiencing, and I think that we need leaders who are willing to fight on the frontlines to put these issues front and center.

heading: Florida Democrat switches districts after DeSantis redistricting shake-up
text: “We’re on this big adventure together, and we’re going to make it happen.”
